outcome_evidence: The upper drawer is initially closed (frame 0, left_ego_image). The robot approaches and aligns with its handle (frames 30–65, left_ego_image and wrist_image), grasps it (frames 69–79, wrist_image), and pulls the drawer outward, visibly exposing its interior (frames 90–109, image and left_ego_image). After releasing and withdrawing, the drawer remains open through frame 153 (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
